violation_type.title: Electronic CO Detection Sys Connected to Alarm/Smoke Detection Sys-Tested Annually by Company or State or Local Fire Marshal (26 TAC §744.3757(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Electronic CO Detection Sys Connected to Alarm/Smoke Detection Sys-Tested Annually by Company or State or Local Fire Marshal
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have any documentation showing the carbon monoxide detection system was tested in the last 12 months.
